summary: Russia launched its largest ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv of the war while Ukrainian drones struck multiple strategic targets in the Moscow region including an oil depot, a major logistics hub, and an industrial park. Russian forces advanced to within 8 kilometers of Sloviansk as Odesa endured sustained cruise missile, Kh-22, and ballistic missile attacks. Ukrainian air defenses reported downing 81 drones but confirmed hits on nine locations.
key_points: Russia fired the largest number of ballistic missiles at Kyiv for the entire war per Ukrainian officials. (Source: @UkraineNow/82781)
Ukrainian drones attacked Podolsk oil depot, Wildberries logistics hub, and Domodedovo industrial park in Moscow region. (Source: @eRadarrua/101779, @eRadarrua/101780, @eRadarrua/101778)
Russian forces are approximately 8 kilometers from Sloviansk according to a Russian company commander. (Source: @tass_agency/386021)

Odesa region faces sustained attacks including Kh-22 missiles, cruise missiles, ballistic threats, and "Banderolet" munitions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69247, @mon1tor_ua/69251, @mon1tor_ua/69257, @mon1tor_ua/69260, @mon1tor_ua/69262, @mon1tor_ua/69264)
Ukrainian air defense claims 81 drones shot down or suppressed with hits recorded at nine locations. (Source: @kpszsu/69330)
Russian missiles struck civilian grain vessel GOLDEN LEO in Black Sea with three Kh-59/69 missiles. (Source: @UkraineNow/82777)
Protests against Defense Minister Fedorov's dismissal continue in Odesa; Canada pledged 35 LAV 6 ACSV APCs. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31758, @ukr_leaks_eng/31752)
Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed one, injured three, damaged five-story building with two people under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/82774)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched its largest ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv of the war while Ukrainian drones struck multiple strategic targets in the Moscow region including an oil depot, a major logistics hub, and an industrial park. Russian forces advanced to within 8 kilometers of Sloviansk as Odesa endured sustained cruise missile, Kh-22, and ballistic missile attacks. Ukrainian air defenses reported downing 81 drones but confirmed hits on nine locations.

points: Ukrainian drones conducted a massive night attack on the Moscow region on July 20, 2026, striking the Podolsk oil depot, the Wildberries logistics hub in Koledino (Podolsk urban district), and the Domodedovo industrial park "Yuzhniye Vorota" (65,000 sq m) on the MKAD, with hundreds of workers fleeing in panic. (Source: @eRadarrua/101779, @eRadarrua/101780, @eRadarrua/101778)
The SBU reportedly hit three oil depots in Russia's Stavropol region during the same period. (Source: @UkraineNow/82781)
Protests demanding the reinstatement of Defense Minister Fedorov continue in Odesa following his dismissal. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31758)
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney promised delivery of 35 LAV 6 ACSV armored personnel carriers to Ukraine by year-end. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31752)
A subunit named "Budanov's Goats" claimed responsibility for eliminating a Russian scientist-engineer involved in massive shelling of Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/82770)
Nationwide actions demanding Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi's resignation and supporting Fedorov are scheduled across Ukrainian cities. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23665)

Ukrainian air defense forces engaged a large-scale Russian attack involving 2 Kh-59/69 missiles from occupied Crimea and 94 strike UAVs (Shahed, Gerber, Italmas, "Banderolet", "Parody") from Kursk, Millerovo, Orel, Donetsk, and Gvardeyskoye directions. (Source: @kpszsu/69330)
Russia launched its largest ballistic missile attack on Kyiv for the entire full-scale war on July 19, according to Ukrainian sources. (Source: @UkraineNow/82781)
Russian forces are approximately 8 kilometers from Sloviansk per a Russian company commander speaking to TASS. (Source: @tass_agency/386021)
The Russian Ministry of Defense claims AFU lost transport and UAV control points on the Kramatorsk direction. (Source: @tass_agency/386023)
A Russian commander stated AFU uses residential buildings in Sloviansk for defense and cover. (Source: @tass_agency/386019)
Russian air defenses reportedly "disassembled" a Ukrainian armada of 400 drones targeting Moscow, per Russian official Miroshnik. (Source: @tass_agency/386043)
Russia opened a terrorism criminal case after Ukrainian drone attacks injured civilians in the Moscow region. (Source: @tass_agency/386049)
One person was killed and 13 wounded in Bryansk region from Ukrainian strikes, per the acting governor. (Source: @tass_agency/386056)
Russian forces have advanced to within approximately 8 kilometers of Sloviansk according to a Russian company commander. (Source: @tass_agency/386021)
The Russian Ministry of Defense claims Ukrainian forces lost transport and UAV control points on the Kramatorsk direction. (Source: @tass_agency/386023)
A Russian commander reported Ukrainian forces use residential buildings in Sloviansk for defensive positions and cover. (Source: @tass_agency/386019)
Reactive UAVs were observed in the Donbas area past Oleksandrivka moving toward the Kharkiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/69319)
Russian missile and drone attacks continue targeting eastern Ukrainian positions and rear areas. (Source: @kpszsu/69330, @mon1tor_ua/69265)
A Russian strike on a Kharkiv suburb killed three people and injured 13 according to the Oblast Military Administration. (Source: @UkraineNow/82768)
Nova Poshta warehouses in the Kharkiv region were reportedly attacked. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31753, @UkraineNow/82781)

Multiple UAV movements detected: Sumy region past Hlukhiv on southwest course; Chernihiv region toward Pryluky from northeast; reactive UAV past Krasnopavlivka in southern Kharkiv region on northwest course. (Source: @kpszsu/69320, @kpszsu/69325, @kpszsu/69333)
Sumy region UAVs tracked toward Mykolaivka/Stepanivka and a likely reconnaissance UAV southwest of Vorozhba heading to Ulyanivka. (Source: @kpszsu/69284, @kpszsu/69331)
Reactive UAVs spotted in Poltava region south of Karlivka moving west and on Hrebinka. (Source: @kpszsu/69324, @eRadarrua/101747)
Chernihiv region UAV activity reported on the border. (Source: @eRadarrua/101747)

Odesa region under sustained multi-axis attack: Kh-22/32 missiles from Tu-22M3 bombers, cruise missiles (Kh-59/69), ballistic missiles (Iskander-M threat from Taganrog), and "Banderolet" barrage munitions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69247, @mon1tor_ua/69251, @mon1tor_ua/69257, @mon1tor_ua/69260, @mon1tor_ua/69262, @mon1tor_ua/69264, @mon1tor_ua/69265, @eRadarrua/101770)
Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed one, injured three, significantly damaged a five-story building, hit near a nine-story building with a woman and child under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/82774)

Russian forces struck the civilian dry cargo vessel GOLDEN LEO (Guinea-Bissau flag, Turkish owner) with three Kh-59/69 missiles in the Black Sea as it exited the combat zone with grain cargo. (Source: @UkraineNow/82777)
Occupied Crimea installing landline phones for emergency communication due to mobile outages and power restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/82764)
UAV detected from Black Sea waters toward Zatoka. (Source: @kpszsu/69334)
